description: Take a crew's work over so the user can work on its branch on their own machine. `ref` is a work item id, crew id, pull request URL or branch. The crew halts (a running one stops at its next step) and nothing resumes it until anyforge_handback_work or a steward releases it. Answers the branch, base branch, pull request, the recent run history and `gitCommands`: run them from a clone of the repository for an isolated worktree on the branch. When `runnerStopping` is true the crew was running and may push one last commit before it stops: fetch the branch again before working. Picking up a crew the user already holds answers the same claim (alreadyHeld). Refused with crew_taken_over (someone else has it), crew_at_gate (decide its approval first), crew_finished or crew_has_no_branch. Only call when the user asks to take the work over. Requires `approve` scope and a key that belongs to a person.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

ref.description: A work item id, crew id, pull request URL or branch name.

repo.description: The repository (owner/name) a branch name is looked up in. Pass it with a branch; a branch in several repositories is refused as ambiguous_ref without it.

name: anyforge_pickup_work
title: Pickup work
